statistical_method.continuous: same-seed paired differences; Student-t 95% CI; Cohen dz and Hedges gz
statistical_method.primary_rescue_service_test: two-sided exact sign-flip randomization test across the predeclared 8 contrasts x 4 scenes; Holm corrected as one family
statistical_method.binary_recovery_test: exact paired McNemar binomial test; Holm corrected separately for first and sustained recovery families
statistical_method.recovery_time: successful-run time reports n/total; all-run paired endpoint uses scenario horizon as censor time for unrecovered runs
statistical_method.latency: conditional per policy on connected user-time samples, sample count reported; no paired latency test across different served-user sets
statistical_method.resource_metrics: paired intervals/effect sizes are reported; no confirmatory superiority claim is made from resource-only endpoints

conditional_latency_summary.comparison_note: each policy conditions on its own connected user-time samples; do not interpret as a paired same-user latency effect
